description: Engine setup of map4_s03 (Mall and boss fight), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type SPU, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: Twinfeeler). "effect_draws" lists the effect slot drawers the map has; an effect slot of any other kind is not drawn. Here: acid (acid spit and its splashes). "character_effects": Twinfeeler draws its own map effects here (the burrow holes and dust of effects/ground_fx.json TwinfeelerBurrow, the acid spit, the effect texture TEST/WARMTEST.TIM); on a map that does not list it, its sh.entity.twinfeeler_* binds do nothing, as in the original. A mod changes it with its own maps/map4_s03/overlay.json.
